chain: 1. Job goes 'stale' with EMPTY error_summary (job writes heartbeat only on success, so a failure leaves no error text).
2. Sentinel failure path (nuzantara-sentinel.py:732) calls add_to_dlq(last_error='') unconditionally; cooldown gates only send_alert (Telegram), not add_to_dlq.

3. dlq-autopilot every 30min: process_entry passes TERMINAL guard (not yet terminal) + max_attempts, hits 'if len(error) < MIN_ERROR_LEN(20)' (dlq_autopilot.py:486) -> escalate_to_claude_code() EVERY tick -> appends 1 JSONL line + writes claude_tasks/*.json + (cooldown-muted) Telegram. escalate_to_claude_code NEVER consulted escalation_cooldown.json.
4. After ~10 ticks (~5h) attempts hit max -> status=TERMINAL -> TERMINAL guard finally skips it. Storm ends for that job until the next stale-with-empty-error job starts the next ~5h storm.
root_cause_W61_storm_relay.W61_2026-05-28_fix_assessment: PARTIAL. The TERMINAL-state guard + add_to_dlq attempts-preservation (repairer.py:144) correctly bound each storm to ~5h/job and prevent duplicate DLQ entries. But they do NOT stop per-tick JSONL/claude_tasks growth DURING the 5h climb. dedup-on-job-key already exists and is NOT the problem.

judgment_calls_for_antonello.Q1_rotation_commit_default: DECIDED OFF. A cron must not git-commit a shared worktree mid-session (cicatrix W50/W51/W59). judgment_calls_for_antonello.Q2_per_job_cooldown_false_negative: ACCEPTED. The 4h cooldown is per-JOB not per-error-hash, so a genuinely-new distinct error for an already-DLQ'd job is suppressed in the JSONL for up to 4h. Acceptable: full error history remains in the DLQ entry + SQLite mirror + the TERMINAL alert bypasses cooldown. OVERRIDE: switch to per-error-hash cooldown if a known-failing job's NEW errors must escalate immediately.
